searchText: Hey fellows and mentors, My presentation during Office Hours #4 and #5 didn’t happen because I was held up in the hospital But I’m back home now, and I’ve recorded my presentation https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y047VIkHe9Q and attached the slides here (Grandine: Implementing Tokio Tracing for Debugging and Performance Analysis) https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D4-0p7T0YNvQvcVLxOh7VFKiwiJnnE8E/view?usp=sharing So you still can get the full show! 😄 <@&857649635274915900> Our first proper Office Hours with Barnabas from EthPandaOps is today at <t:1753887600:t>! Make sure to join us to meet him, learn about his work and ask for some tips to guide you during the fellowship. If you cannot attend, post your questions in advance under the issue: https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-six/issues/213 10 years of Ethereum stream starting now! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=igPIMF1p5Bo Office hours starting now! https://meet.ethereum.org/epf-office-hours https://github.com/ethpandaops/assertoor https://www.loom.com/share/f7d32d0af14f4f24b63bf3cebfdc796a James (from Prysm) made a great introduction running local devnet using ethereum-package and kurtosis. (Just 3 min, worth watching) this would be a great addition to epf wiki!
